India and Pakistan clash over UN map and Kashmir

India and Pakistan engaged in a diplomatic exchange following India's remarks at the United Nations regarding a map. Pakistan reacted strongly to India's statement and reiterated its stance on Jammu and Kashmir. India responded to Pakistan's provocation. The dispute centers on the depiction of Jammu and Kashmir in a map used at the UN.
